title: India GST HSN starter headings
notes: Four-digit goods heading starter list. Descriptions are concise heading-level summaries based on the Indian Customs Tariff / GSTN HSN directory. Common-use notes are plain-language examples for search only, not official classifications or tax advice. Confirm the exact HSN/SAC, description, rate and applicable reporting digits for each product or service using the GST Portal and current CBIC notifications before issuing a tax invoice.

entries.description: Milk and cream, not concentrated nor containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
entries.usage: Fresh milk and cream; verify fat content and processing.

entries.description: Potatoes, fresh or chilled
entries.usage: Fresh or chilled potatoes.

entries.description: Rice
